description: SLA - Tracés des lignes de bus - Réseau Distribus is a dataset listed in Open Data Saint-Louis Agglomération, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Saint-Louis Agglomération. Tracés des lignes de bus du réseau Distribus sur le territoire de Saint-Louis Agglomération. Au total, 14 lignes de bus desservent le territoire via ce réseau. Ci-dessous (dans la partie "Pièces jointes"), vous trouverez également le plan schématique du réseau Distribus de l'agglomération au format PDF. Coverage: Saint-Louis Agglomération (Haut-Rhin). The portal files it under Transports, Mobilités. Its keywords are distribus, mobilité, transport en commun. The portal shows 14 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-05-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-saint-louis-agglo-portal.
